input:
Earlier scenes:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。然后，神农开始尝很多植物，比方说他吃过生姜、芥兰和菠菜。一些植物吃真好，特别是黄瓜。但是，一些植物毒得很，特别是夹竹桃。

This scene:
一个人对神农说，麻烦我们可以吃什么植物？神农说，这就要看你想不想生病了。以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 麻烦我们可以吃什么植物：麻烦告诉我们……
- 以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃：后来，Time+以后；告诉人们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”；哪些，哪些

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 麻烦我们可以吃什么植物：请问，我们可以吃什么植物？，麻烦 means “to trouble/request” and cannot by itself introduce a polite question; 请问 is the appropriate question-opening expression here. [rule: word_choice]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 这就要看你想不想生病了：这就要看是什么植物了，this pattern should give a flexible answer to the question of which plants are edible; the part after 看 needs to be the relevant question, here what kind of plant it is. [rule: zhe_jiu_yao_kan]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 以后：后来，when a sentence begins with “afterwards,” use 后来 rather than 以后. [vocab list]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别人：人们，别人 distinguishes other people from a person or group already being discussed; here the intended general group is people in general. [teacher rule: bieren]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农告诉：他告诉，because 神农 was the subject in the immediately preceding sentence and no competing character has appeared, a pronoun makes the close re-occurrence smoother. [rule: redundancy_delete]

items.reason: 麻烦 cannot directly introduce this question, while 请问，我们可以吃什么植物？ is correct.
这就要看你想不想生病了 is a correct use of the required 这就要看……了 pattern.
以后 needs a stated time before it here, so 后来 is the appropriate narrative-time word.
别人 means other people distinct from a specified person or group, whereas 人们 fits people in general.
The repeated close reference should be 他, but both the before and after excerpts stop after 告诉 and omit the rest of the clause.
